---
title: Open a Unidirectional Fiber Channel
description: Fund a private one-way channel and send a Testnet payment from initiator to acceptor
date: 2026-08-17
full: true
---

This interactive tutorial opens a private unidirectional channel from a Fiber
WASM browser node to a public Testnet peer. Inspect the payer and acceptor roles,
follow the on-chain funding lifecycle, and send a real off-chain payment in the
permitted direction.
